en.about:
Add what everyone paid, and Split Bill works out who owes whom.
Settle up in SALT from the chat, with an invoice for each friend.
highlights: Works in groups of up to 20
en.privacy: Keeps the bills you add for 90 days, under the ID it sees for you. It never sees your address unless you share it.
en.tagline: Split a bill with friends in two taps

ru.about:
Добавьте, кто сколько заплатил, и Split Bill посчитает, кто кому должен.
Рассчитайтесь в SALT прямо из чата: каждому другу — свой счёт.
ru.privacy: Хранит добавленные вами счета 90 дней под идентификатором, который видит для вас. Ваш адрес не видит, пока вы им не поделитесь.
ru.tagline: Разделите счёт с друзьями в два касания

en.about: Example DEX finds the best rate across the network's books. Every swap is a transaction you sign in Saltix.
highlights: No deposit: your coins stay yours
en.privacy: Keeps nothing about you. Your address is public on the blockchain; the page reads your balances from a node.
en.tagline: Swap SALT and WORK at the best price

rules: ConnectProfile: Borsh {version u8 = 1, subject Subject, owner [32], revision u32 ≥ 1, texts Map<String, ProfileText> (u32 count, entries sorted by key, each u32 length + UTF-8 key then the value), website Option<String>, support Option<String>, terms Option<String>}
Subject: tag 0 Grain {slug String} | tag 1 Site {origin String, name String, category u8}
ProfileText: Borsh {tagline String, about String, highlights Vec<String>, privacy String}

SignedConnectProfile: Borsh {profile, key DeviceKey (tag 0 Ed25519 [32], tag 1 P256 [33] compressed), signature [64]}; a reader takes only the canonical encoding: it re-encodes what it decoded and refuses any difference (keys out of order or repeated, trailing bytes)
message = BLAKE3 derive_key("Saltix connect profile v1", Borsh(ConnectProfile)); an Ed25519 key signs the 32 bytes (strict verification), a P-256 key signs SHA-256 of them as r ‖ s with s ≤ n/2

characters are Unicode scalar values; refused everywhere: Unicode Cc and Cf (connect-v1.json's list) and U+2028, U+2029; a line feed (U+000A) only in about; no text starts or ends with a space (U+0020) or a line feed
tagline 1–80 characters; about 0–600; highlights 0–4, each 1–60; privacy 0–300; texts 1–8 languages, each code 2–8 of [a-z-], "en" among them
subject: a grain's slug as 12-grains §2 (3–32 of [a-z0-9-], not starting with '-'); a site's origin as an offer's (connect-v1.json), its name 1–32 characters, its category 0–9

website and terms: "https://" then an origin as a browser serializes it (lowercase host, no user, no default port) and optionally a path, query or fragment; printable ASCII without spaces; at most 256 bytes

support: such an https link, or "mailto:" one address (local part 1–64 of [A-Za-z0-9.!#$%&'*+/=^_`{|}~-], no leading, trailing or double dot; a lowercase domain of at least two labels; nothing after it; at most 256 bytes), or a Saltix username "@name" in its canonical form (21-names)
the Borsh form of the profile is at most 8192 bytes

for a grain: the subject's slug is the grain's and owner the registry's owner of it; the registry takes it only from the owner (SetGrainProfile) with a key that speaks for the owner and a revision above the one it holds

for a site: the subject's origin is the offer's; the key speaks for owner by the owner's key event log (account_log): an empty log and the owner's own Ed25519 key (personal id), or a log that checks offline whose controller lists the key as a device that is not a guardian
reasons are checked in this order: encoding, version, subject, revision, languages, tagline, about, highlights, privacy, website, support, terms, size, signature, then service, owner, key
SetGrainProfile: RegistryCall tag 38 {slug String, profile Option<SignedConnectProfile>}; value 0; none clears the profile

profile link (12-grains §10): "salt:grain-profile?p=" then base64url without padding of the raw DEFLATE (RFC 1951) of Borsh(ConnectProfile) with owner 32 zero bytes and revision 0; at most 2048 characters in all; one stream with nothing after it, inflating to at most 8192 bytes of canonical Borsh of a grain's profile; the link here is compressed at level 9 by miniz, and a reader takes any valid stream, never re-compressing; refused links name their reason: link, size, encoding, inflate, profile, owned, subject
